凌厌执没有回答，眼睛斜斜地瞥了一眼旁边的人。
医生懂了：“是这样的，资料显示简小姐还在寻亲。我想着这么多年都没有找到亲生父母，很有可能是基因子库里的数据没有跟您对应上的。”
她现实中是有尝试过寻亲，但高中辍学之后，她就再也没有这个念头了。
就她这么烂的身体，一看就是被故意遗弃的。
医生的话还在响起，“基因数据并入总库，机会能更大一些。”
剧情偏太多，路人甲的人设崩塌，走一步算一步，不行就后退两步，她没得选择。
医生面色迟疑，没死心，“其实，简小姐长得，和秦家夫人有几分相似。说不定……”
他认真地打量了一番简妤的眉眼，“那种势利女人，你也好意思说有几分相似？”
“不不不，您误会了，我说的是秦家已故的那位沈夫人。”
凌厌执似乎也知道沈夫人，没再出声讽刺。
他看向简妤，没替她决定，不紧不慢地介绍，“秦家在贵族里面，算中层。没记错的话，他家今年也有人就读威斯嵐贵族学院。”
威斯嵐贵族学院，简妤差点忘记这个拗口的校名。
“算了，我不想跟秦家扯上关系。”简妤毫不犹豫地开口。
认亲是不可能的，她只打算私底下悄悄查一查秦家。
亲生父母肯定不知道她身上具备有安抚觉醒者的气息，不然也不会轻易弃婴。
可她的际遇又是什么情况？原主本身就有，还是她穿来之后才有的？
设定过分熟悉，古早霸总小说里面，霸总经常失眠，只能抱着女主，闻着女主身上的体香入睡。
“可以的话，我希望。”简妤没有说完。

医生立马接话，“我保证不会说出去。”
“纠结什么？不想认就不认，秦家大腿又没我粗。”
凌厌执低头拨弄星脑，“我帮你查查，让你心里有个底？”
小小验证一下，要是符合，她再决定要不要迈下一步。
“简单。”凌厌执意味不明地哼笑一声，脑瓜子还挺聪明。
现实世界里，她自学有一些黑客技术，原主同样也是。
但记忆中，她学的那些，跟原主学的操作出入很大。
“小看我？”凌厌执挑眉，屏幕共享给她看。
简妤抿了抿嘴，时不时看他一眼，“有点帅。”
凌厌执眼皮都没抬，“就不能说点我不知道的事？”
“查到了。”凌厌执手指蜷缩，声音放得很轻。
简妤眼睛低垂，下意识地松了口气。
两个O型血，生不出B型血的孩子。
凌厌执弯腰，抱她出门：“别撒娇。”

Was he forcefully kissed at the beginning of the beast school? The latest chapter of I was pampered by crazy critics_Chapter 13: Don’t act like a spoiled brat Page 1_Being forcefully kissed at the beginning of the beast school? I was spoiled by crazy critics Mengmeng Qiqi_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 13: Don’t act like a spoiled brat (page 1)
Ling Yanzhi didn't answer, and glanced sideways at the person next to him.
The doctor understood: "That's right, the data shows that Miss Jian is still looking for relatives. I think that if you haven't found your biological parents for so many years, it is very likely that the data in the gene bank does not correspond to yours."
In reality, she had tried to find a relative, but after dropping out of high school, she no longer had the idea.
With her body in such a bad state, it looked like it had been deliberately abandoned.
The doctor's words are still ringing, "If the genetic data is merged into the general database, the chances will be greater."
The plot was too much, and the character of Passerby A collapsed. She had to take one step at a time, or take two steps back if it didn't work. She had no choice.
The doctor looked hesitant but did not give up, "Actually, Miss Jian looks somewhat similar to Mrs. Qin. Maybe..."
He carefully looked at Jian Yu's features and said, "You have the nerve to tell me how similar she is to that snobbish woman?"
"No, no, no, you misunderstood. I am talking about the late Mrs. Shen of the Qin family."
Ling Yanzhi seemed to know about Mrs. Shen and did not make any sarcasm.
He looked at Jian Yu and did not decide for her. He introduced her in a leisurely manner, "The Qin family is considered to be the middle class among the nobility. If I remember correctly, someone from his family is also studying at the Weislan Noble Academy this year."
Weislan Noble Academy, Jian Yu almost forgot this awkward name.
"Forget it, I don't want to have anything to do with the Qin family." Jian Yu said without hesitation.
It was impossible to recognize her relatives. She only planned to check the Qin family in private.
The biological parents definitely didn't know that she had the aura to comfort the awakened ones, otherwise they wouldn't have abandoned the baby so easily.
But what is her fate? Did the original owner have it himself, or did it come after she wore it?
The setting is too familiar. In ancient novels about bosses, the boss often suffers from insomnia and can only fall asleep holding the heroine in his arms and smelling her body fragrance.
"If possible, I hope." Jian Yu did not finish her sentence.
The doctor answered immediately, "I promise I won't tell anyone."
"What are you struggling with? If you don't want to admit it, just admit it. The Qin family's thighs are not as thick as mine."
Ling Yanzhi lowered his head and played with Xing's brain, "Shall I check it for you so that you can have some idea?"
A little verification, and if it matches, she will decide whether to take the next step.
"Simple." Ling Yanzhi chuckled without meaning, he was quite smart.
In the real world, she taught herself some hacking skills, and so did the original owner.
But in her memory, the operations she learned were very different from the operations learned by her original owner.
"Looking down on me?" Ling Yanzhi raised his eyebrows and shared the screen with her.
Jian Yu pursed her lips and glanced at him from time to time, "A bit handsome."
Ling Yanzhi didn't even raise his eyelids, "Can't you tell me something I don't know?"
"Found it." Ling Yan curled his fingers and spoke very softly.
Jian Yu lowered her eyes and breathed a sigh of relief subconsciously.
Two people with type O blood cannot give birth to a child with type B blood.
Ling Yanzhi bent down and carried her out: "Don't act like a baby."
